Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office is seeking Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (quantity 30) and Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks WD22TB4 (quantity 30) with 3-year extended warranty. Bids are due June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM EDT and must be submitted electronically through Maryland's eMMA e-Procurement system, with delivery required within 45 days of award. Invoices shall be submitted within 10 days of equipment delivery. Bidders must provide a Mercury Affidavit and warranty certificate or affidavit upon award, register Dell as the manufacturer, and use the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007). Contact Tamaira Hawkins at thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us or 410-260-7533 for questions.
